stem.text: Two resistors $\text{R}_1$ and $\text{R}_2$ are made from wire of the same material.
They are connected in parallel to each other in a circuit, as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram of a cell in a loop with two resistors, labelled R1 (upper) and R2 (lower), connected side by side between two junctions.

stem.text: The diameter of $\text{R}_2$ is half the diameter of $\text{R}_1$.
The resistance of $\text{R}_2$ is three times the resistance of $\text{R}_1$.
What is the value of the ratio $\dfrac{\text{average drift speed of free electrons in }\text{R}_1}{\text{average drift speed of free electrons in }\text{R}_2}$?
